body:
CURRENT ENGRAM RUN RULE (Engram::Fable; rev 14, 2026-11-06 15:03Z, compacted; history is in revisions 1-13).
SOURCE: GREG DIRECT via Engram::Advisor #2499 (2026-10-31 22:46Z), verbatim: "Greg sugeruje podzial pracy: Windows A do kodowania zmian i przygotowania paczek; test runy na pozostalych maszynach remote. Prosze organizowac wszystkie mozliwe focused i full runs na DL560/Mac/Windows B przez natywne sesje i mailbox, Windows B dla testow zależnych od Windows. Central tylko gdy istnieje konkretna techniczna potrzeba. Nie dokladac recznych procedur; podajcie realne uruchomienia i usuncie sztuczne ograniczenia." Also Greg 2026-11-06: remote tests only through registered project sessions on that host (memory rules-greg-remote-tests-via-project-sessions-2026-11-06).
1. Windows A (Central): coding and packaging. Cargo there only for a named concrete need, under Termal::Opus2's named Central GO (one Cargo job at a time).
2. Jobs go directly from an Engram coder or merger to a runner by native mail: a git bundle of the exact commit (its prerequisite must be a commit the runner holds), the tree and the exact argv. The runner's census is the admission rule for FOCUSED jobs. Every FULL on DL560 needs Opus2's named slot GO: ONE shared DL560 FULL queue for both projects (agreed with Fable2 #6696/#6697, 2026-11-06). One fresh worktree and target per job; no retry of unchanged input without a concrete reason; a never-started job is withdrawn and confirmed "withdrawn, not started" before being resent. Runners have no tracker route; owners record ENDs and gates.
3. RUNNERS:
- DL560 (host:e83d08f4-22ac-4655-a84d-941fc0eeb4f1): Engram jobs ONLY via session-4 (Central mirror 15580, project "DL560 · Engram runner", root /home/greg/github/Engram-runner, deliberately NOT connected to an Engram store; writes via domain mailbox 4369f879). Session-1 "Codex Live" serves TermAl only (it belongs to the TermAl project, so Engram registrations there were refused with 400). Census: MemAvailable ≥64 GiB, disk ≥60 GB plus footprint, load <64 with a numeric reading before every command, CARGO_BUILD_JOBS 48.
- Windows B (host:932a546b-4ab2-49a7-a5cb-499cbfac2eab::session-9, relay mailbox): Windows-dependent tests and full gates; at most 1 full or 2 focused jobs; ≥25 GiB free commit. Its dispatch helper must use exact argv arrays (a PowerShell .Replace once broadened a focused run; request 161 was interrupted).
- Mac 6201 (host:abf8bda6-1ac7-485c-91ce-5a06ac453653::session-6201, clone /Users/greg/GitHub/Personal/Engram-runner): ordinary Unix lane, FIFO, ≥60 GB free after the footprint.
4. SOURCE-OWNER BINARY for the launcher's `engram source` adapter (from w-a6c91d6a7f27's child w-281e3c5b8233; it applies once that lands). Default $CARGO_HOME/bin/engram, else ~/.cargo/bin/engram; override with an absolute ENGRAM_SOURCE_BINARY per process; no PATH or autobuild; missing means unavailable, never plain. Per lane:
- Central: the installed C:\Users\grzeg\.cargo\bin\engram.exe (standing-approval installs).
- DL560: the installed /home/greg/.cargo/bin/engram (2d03fd4e, 13:00Z 2026-11-06).
- Windows B: NO installed engram. Pass ENGRAM_SOURCE_BINARY=C:\GitHub\Personal\Engram-runner\target\pinned\engram-2d03fd4e8cbb9f2d1d1b34bc327cb170a04e3e3d.exe (SHA256 a7d491e8…).
- Mac: NO installed engram. Pass ENGRAM_SOURCE_BINARY=/Users/greg/GitHub/Personal/Engram-runner/target/pinned/engram-source-2d03fd4e8cbb9f2d1d1b34bc327cb170a04e3e3d (SHA256 5bfe66ec…).
Never install outside the repo without Greg's word; refresh the pins after a landing that changes reader semantics (e.g. w-9396 EOL), explicitly and recorded. Tests always point at the candidate's own build, never at the pin.
5. STANDING RUNNER CLEANUP: when the census refuses an Engram job for space, the runner may delete the Cargo build output under its own finished jobs' target/, oldest first, only as much as needed. Use absolute paths inside the clone, checked, no symlinks out. KEEP worktrees, target/tmp and home, inputs, review-runs, logs, fixtures and target/pinned. Never an active job or a protected TermAl lane. Log each deletion in .logs/ and report it in the next END.
